conditions: The relevant parameter is specified by the ordinary value-parameter provision §6.6.3.2. The declared formal type must also be eligible as a file component type, as referenced by the clause.
limitations: This is the language's parameter rule. It does not specify argument evaluation order, machine-level copying, or conformant-array parameter rules.
Exact unextended ISO/IEC 7185:1990 online replica. The replica gives the printed text precedence where they differ. ISO 10206 Extended Pascal and product dialects require separate evidence.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, confirmed online-to-printed discrepancy, exact artifact drift, or contrary applicable evidence.

statement: ISO/IEC 7185:1990 requires an ordinary value argument to be an expression with an assignment-compatible value. On block activation the expression's current value is assigned to the variable denoted by the formal parameter.
